en.io: Takes SwiftUI source code, architecture descriptions, or profiling trace exports as input, and outputs diagnostic reports, root-cause analyses, and refactored code fixes.
en.boundary: It does not directly execute Xcode, perform live device profiling, or build application code automatically.
scenarios: Diagnosing janky scrolling, frame drops, or slow view rendering in complex SwiftUI layouts.
Fixing excessive view updates and invalidation storms caused by broad state observation.
Guiding users through Xcode Instruments profiling when code analysis alone is inconclusive.

zh.io: 输入 SwiftUI 源代码、数据流架构说明或性能轨迹截图/导出文件，输出诊断报告、根因分析及重构代码。
zh.boundary: 该技能无法直接自动运行 Xcode、在真机上执行实时性能测量或自动构建应用代码。
scenarios: 诊断和解决复杂 SwiftUI 布局或列表中的卡顿、掉帧及渲染缓慢问题。
定位并修复因状态观察粒度过大导致的视图过度更新与无效化风暴。
在代码审查不足以推断原因时，指导用户使用 Xcode Instruments 采集并分析性能轨迹。
